headline: Chelsea's João Pedro withdraws from Brazil squad with injury
description: Chelsea striker João Pedro has withdrawn from the Brazil squad because of injury.

headline: Arsenal's Mikel Merino: 'Special talent' Max Dowman has similarities with Lamine Yamal
description: Arsenal midfielder Mikel Merino has hailed Max Dowman as a "special talent" and believes there are similarities to his Spanish compatriot Lamine Yamal.

headline: Omar Marmoush certain Tottenham close to finding the key to unlock their attack
description: Spurs summer signing Omar Marmoush believes Tottenham are close to finding the key to turn around their terrible start to the season.

headline: João Pedro wants a new nickname for Chelsea's goalscoring trio
description: João Pedro called for a new nickname for Chelsea's in-form front three as he discussed his growing understanding with Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Barça, Madrid believe Haaland could exit Man City next summer
description: Could LaLiga giants Barcelona and Real Madrid make a move for Manchester City star Erling Haaland next summer?Transfer talk has the latest.

headline: Soccer should learn from the NFL to fix the mess that VAR has created
description: Is it time to give the VAR the red card, or does soccer actually need the red flag? The Manchester derby controversy could have been avoided with an on-field challenge.
